items.e: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from Ibrahim al-Khazzaz Abu Ayyub from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man who was unconscious for days, and did not pray, then regained consciousness. Should he make up what he missed? Imam (a.s) said: “There is nothing (of qadha) upon him.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ اَلْخَزَّازِ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَيَّاماً لَمْ يُصَلِّ ثُمَّ أَفَاقَ أَ يُصَلِّي مَا فَاتَهُ قَالَ« لاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Hadid from Murazim who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a sick person who is not able to perform the prayer. Imam (a.s) said: “Whatever Allah (swt) has caused to overcome him (to faint), then Allah (swt) is more entitled to excuse.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ حَدِيدٍ عَنْ مُرَازِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلصَّلاَةِ قَالَ فَقَالَ« كُلَّمَا غَلَبَ اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فَاللَّهُ أَوْلَى بِالْعُذْرِ»

items.e: From him, from al-Hajjal from Tha‘labah ibn Maymun from Ma‘mar ibn Umar who said: I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about the sick person, does he make up the prayer if he was unconscious? Imam (a.s) said: “No.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَجَّالِ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ مَعْمَرِ بْنِ عُمَرَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ إِذَا أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ« لاَ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman who said: I wrote to the jurist (faqih) Abu al-Hasan al-Askari (a.s), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s) about the one who falls unconscious for a day or more. Does he have to make up the prayers that he missed or not? So Imam (a.s) wrote: “He does not make up the fast, nor does he make up the prayer.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى اَلْفَقِيهِ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلْعَسْكَرِيِّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ هَلْ يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ أَمْ لاَ فَكَتَبَ« لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّوْمَ وَ لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ»

items.e: Sa’ad from Ayyub ibn Nuh who said: I wrote to Abu al-Hasan al-Thalith (a.s) (the Third), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s) about the one who falls unconscious for a day or more. Does he have to make up the prayers that he missed or not? So Imam (a.s) wrote: “He does not make up the fast, nor does he make up the prayer.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ نُوحٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلثَّالِثِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً أَوْ أَكْثَرَ هَلْ يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ أَمْ لاَ فَكَتَبَ« لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّوْمَ وَ لاَ يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ»

items.e: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Hasan from Zur'ah from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about the sick person who falls unconscious. He said: “If three days pass over him, then there is no obligation upon him to make it up; and if he is unconscious for three days, then he must make up the prayers during them.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ قَالَ« إِذَا جَازَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلاَثَةُ أَيَّامٍ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ وَ إِذَا أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ ثَلاَثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فَعَلَيْهِ قَضَاءُ اَلصَّلاَةِ فِيهِنَّ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Yaqub ibn Yazid from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hafs from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the one who falls unconscious. Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up the prayer of one day.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ يَعْقُوبَ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ قَالَ فَقَالَ« يَقْضِي صَلاَةَ يَوْمٍ»

items.e: From him, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Alaa ibn al-Fudayl, said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man who falls unconscious from the day until the night, then regains consciousness. Imam (a.s) said: “If he regains consciousness before sunset, then he must make up the prayer of that day. But if he remains unconscious for a number of days, then he is only required to make up the prayer of the last of those days, if he regains consciousness before sunset. Otherwise, there is nothing upon him to make up.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْجَبَّارِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ اَلْفُضَيْلِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ يَوْماً إِلَى اَللَّيْلِ ثُمَّ يُفِيقُ قَالَ« إِنْ أَفَاقَ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ اَلشَّمْسِ فَعَلَيْهِ قَضَاءُ يَوْمِهِ هَذَا فَإِنْ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ أَيَّاماً ذَوَاتِ عَدَدٍ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ إِلاَّ آخِرَ أَيَّامِهِ إِنْ أَفَاقَ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ إِلاَّ فَلَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ»

items.e: And Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Ali ibn Ri’ab from Abu Basir from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them, who said: I asked Imam (a.s) about the sick person, who falls unconscious and then regains consciousness, how does he make up his prayer? Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up the prayer whose time he caught.”
items.o: وَ رَوَى أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُفِيقُ كَيْفَ يَقْضِي صَلاَتَهُ قَالَ« يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ اَلَّتِي أَدْرَكَ وَقْتَهَا»

items.e: Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman from Ubaydullah al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam (a.s) about the sick person, does he make up the prayer if he falls unconscious? Imam (a.s) said: “No, except for the prayer during which he regained consciousness.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ هَلْ يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ إِذَا أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ« لاَ إِلاَّ اَلصَّلاَةَ اَلَّتِي أَفَاقَ فِيهَا»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hafs from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “He makes up the prayer during which he regained consciousness.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَفْصٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« يَقْضِي اَلصَّلاَةَ اَلَّتِي أَفَاقَ فِيهَا»

items.e: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (a.s): Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Everything you left of your prayer due to an illness, in which you were rendered unconscious, make it up when you regain consciousness.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنِ اِبْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كُلُّ شَيْءٍ تَرَكْتَهُ مِنْ صَلاَتِكَ لِمَرَضٍ أُغْمِيَ عَلَيْكَ فِيهِ فَاقْضِهِ إِذَا أَفَقْتَ»

items.e: From him, from Safwan from al-Alaa from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far (a.s), who said: I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s) about the man who falls unconscious, and then regains consciousness. Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up what he missed, he gives the adhan for the first prayer and gives the iqamah for the rest (when making up missed prayers).”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُفِيقُ قَالَ« يَقْضِي مَا فَاتَهُ يُؤَذِّنَ فِي اَلْأُولَى وَ يُقِيمُ فِي اَلْبَقِيَّةِ»

items.e: From him, from Safwan from Mansur ibn Hazim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding the one who falls unconscious. Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up everything that he missed.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ قَالَ« يَقْضِي كُلَّ مَا فَاتَهُ»

items.e: From him, from Ibn Abi Umayr from Rifaa'ah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the one who falls unconscious for a month, what does he make up of the prayer? Imam (a.s) said: “He makes up all of it. Indeed, the matter of prayer is severe.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ شَهْراً مَا يَقْضِي مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ قَالَ« يَقْضِيهَا كُلَّهَا إِنَّ أَمْرَ اَلصَّلاَةِ شَدِيدٌ»

items.e: From him, from Abdullah ibn Muhammad who said: I wrote to him; “May I be ransomed for you, it has been narrated from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, regarding a sick person who becomes unconscious for several days. Some have said he makes up the prayer of the day in which he regains consciousness, and some have said he makes up the prayers of three days and leaves what is beyond that, and some have said that there is no make-up upon him.” So Imam (a.s) wrote: “He makes up the prayer of the day in which he regains consciousness.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَيْهِ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ رُوِيَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي اَلْمَرِيضِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ أَيَّاماً فَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ يَقْضِي صَلاَةَ يَوْمِهِ اَلَّذِي أَفَاقَ فِيهِ وَقَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ يَقْضِي صَلاَةَ ثَلاَثَةِ أَيَّامٍ وَ يَدَعُ مَا سِوَى ذَلِكَ وَ قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ إِنَّهُ لاَ قَضَاءَ عَلَيْهِ فَكَتَبَ« يَقْضِي صَلاَةَ اَلْيَوْمِ اَلَّذِي يُفِيقُ فِيهِ»

items.e: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Hammad ibn Isa from Shu'ayb from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about a man who falls unconscious during the day and then regains consciousness before sunset. Imam (a.s) said: “He performs the Dhuhr and Asr prayers, and if he regains consciousness during the night before dawn, he makes up the night (Isha) prayers.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُغْمَى عَلَيْهِ نَهَاراً ثُمَّ يُفِيقُ قَبْلَ غُرُوبِ اَلشَّمْسِ فَقَالَ« يُصَلِّي اَلظُّهْرَ وَ اَلْعَصْرَ وَ مِنَ اَللَّيْلِ إِذَا أَفَاقَ قَبْلَ اَلصُّبْحِ قَضَى صَلاَةَ اَللَّيْلِ»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about the one suffering from abdominal illness (al-mabtun). Imam (a.s) said: “He builds upon his prayer.” (meaning performs ablution again, and continues from where he left it)
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلْمَبْطُونِ فَقَالَ« يَبْنِي عَلَى صَلاَتِهِ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Mas'ud from Muhammad ibn Nusayr from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ja’far ibn Bashir from Abdullah ibn Bukayr from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The one afflicted with overpowering abdominal illness (sahib al-batn al-ghalib) performs ablution for his prayer and completes what remains.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ نُصَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ بَشِيرٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« صَاحِبُ اَلْبَطْنِ اَلْغَالِبِ يَتَوَضَّأُ فِي صَلاَتِهِ فَيُتِمُّ مَا بَقِيَ»

items.e: From him, from Muhammad ibn Nusayr from Muhammad ibn Isa from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabi from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked about the dripping of urine (incontinence). Imam (a.s) said: “He should place a pouch (khariitah, to absorb), when he prays.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ نُصَيْرٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: سُئِلَ عَنْ تَقْطِيرِ اَلْبَوْلِ قَالَ« يَجْعَلُ خَرِيطَةً إِذَا صَلَّى»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Hasan from Zur'ah from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about the sick person who is not able to sit. He said: “Then let him pray while lying down, and let him place something on his forehead when he prostrates, for it suffices for him. And Allah (swt) will not burden a soul beyond its capacity.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ اَلْجُلُوسَ قَالَ« فَلْيُصَلِّ وَ هُوَ مُضْطَجِعٌ وَ لْيَضَعْ عَلَى جَبْهَتِهِ شَيْئاً إِذَا سَجَدَ فَإِنَّهُ يُجْزِي عَنْهُ وَ لَنْ يُكَلِّفَ اَللَّهُ مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَهُ بِهِ»

items.e: From him, from al-Hasan from Zur'ah from Sama'ah who said: I asked him about a man who has water in his eyes and has it removed, and then lies on his back for many days; forty days, less or more and refrains from prayer during those days while he is in that condition. He said: “There is no harm in that, and there is nothing among what Allah (swt) has forbidden except that He (azj) has made it lawful for the one who is compelled to it.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ زُرْعَةَ عَنْ سَمَاعَةَ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَكُونَ فِي عَيْنَيْهِ اَلْمَاءُ فَيَنْزِعُ اَلْمَاءَ مِنْهَا فَيَسْتَلْقِي عَلَى ظَهْرِهِ اَلْأَيَّامَ اَلْكَثِيرَةَ أَرْبَعِينَ يَوْماً أَقَلَّ أَوْ أَكْثَرَ فَيَمْتَنِعُ مِنَ اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلْأَيَّامَ وَ هُوَ عَلَى حَالٍ فَقَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ بِذَلِكَ وَ لَيْسَ شَيْءٌ مِمَّا حَرَّمَ اَللَّهُ إِلاَّ وَ قَدْ أَحَلَّهُ لِمَنِ اُضْطُرَّ إِلَيْهِ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Safwan from Iys who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about a man upon whom a year's worth of prayer has accumulated, due to illness. Imam (a.s) said: “He does not make them up.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنْ عِيصٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ اِجْتَمَعَ عَلَيْهِ صَلاَةُ سَنَةٍ مِنْ مَرَضٍ قَالَ« لاَ يَقْضِي»

items.e: Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father from Hammad from Hariz from Muhammad ibn Muslim who said: I said to Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “A man fell ill and left the supererogatory prayer (al-nafilah).” Imam said: “O Muhammad, it is not an obligation. If he makes it up, then it is a good deed that he does, and if he does not do it, then there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لَهُ رَجُلٌ مَرِضَ فَتَرَكَ اَلنَّافِلَةَ قَالَ« يَا مُحَمَّدُ لَيْسَتْ بِفَرِيضَةٍ إِنْ قَضَاهَا فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ يَفْعَلُهُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَفْعَلْ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ»

items.e: Ali from his father from Abdullah ibn al-Mughirah from Mu'awiyah ibn Maysarah: that Sinan asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked about a man who stretches out one of his legs in front of him while sitting. Imam (a.s) said: “There is no problem, and I do not see it except, in the case of someone afflicted (al-mu'tall) or sick (al-marid).”
items.o: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ مَيْسَرَةَ: أَنَّ سِنَاناً سَأَلَ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يَمُدُّ إِحْدَى رِجْلَيْهِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَ هُوَ جَالِسٌ قَالَ« لاَ بَأْسَ وَ لاَ أَرَاهُ إِلاَّ فِي اَلْمُعْتَلِّ أَوِ اَلْمَرِيضِ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan from Amr ibn Sa'id from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah from Ammar from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I asked Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) about the sick person, whether it is permissible for him to stand on his bed and prostrate on the ground? Imam (a.s) said: “If the bed is thick to the extent of a brick (ajurrah) or less, then it is correct for him to stand on it and prostrate on the ground. But if it is more than that, then no.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ مُصَدِّقِ بْنِ صَدَقَةً عَنْ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ اَلْمَرِيضِ أَيَحِلُّ لَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ عَلَى فِرَاشِهِ وَ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ قَالَ فَقَالَ« إِذَا كَانَ اَلْفِرَاشُ غَلِيظاً قَدْرَ آجُرَّةٍ أَوْ أَقَلَّ اِسْتَقَامَ لَهُ أَنْ يَقُومَ عَلَيْهِ وَ يَسْجُدَ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ ذَلِكَ فَلاَ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Mas'ud from Hamdawayh from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Ayyub from Isma'il ibn Jabir who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, saying, and a man asked him about a person upon whom the prayer becomes due while he is in water, wading through it, and he is not able to reach the ground. Imam (a.s) said: “If he is in war or on a path among the paths of Allah (swt), then let him gesture with indication (yumi’ ima’an, with his head or eyes). But if he is on a trade journey, then it was not proper for him to enter the water until he had prayed.” He (narrator) said: “I asked: ‘What should he do?’” Imam (a.s) said: “He must make it up when he comes out of the water, and indeed he has been neglectful (of prayer).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ مَسْعُودٍ عَنْ حَمْدَوَيْهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي أَيُّوبَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ وَ سَأَلَهُ إِنْسَانٌ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ تُدْرِكُهُ اَلصَّلاَةُ وَ هُوَ فِي مَاءٍ يَخُوضُهُ لاَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى اَلْأَرْضِ قَالَ« إِنْ كَانَ فِي حَرْبٍ أَوْ سَبِيلٍ مِنْ سُبُلِ اَللَّهِ فَلْيُومِ إِيمَاءً وَ إِنْ كَانَ فِي تِجَارَةٍ فَلَمْ يَكُنْ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يَخُوضَ اَلْمَاءَ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ» قَالَ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ قَالَ« يَقْضِيهَا إِذَا خَرَجَ مِنَ اَلْمَاءِ وَ قَدْ ضَيَّعَ»

items.e: Sa’ad from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Tayalisi from Ibrahim ibn Abi Ziyad al-Karkhi who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “An old man is unable to stand, to go to the toilet, and he cannot perform bowing (rukuh) and prostration (sujud).” Imam (a.s) said: “Then let him gesture with his head by indication (ima'a), and if there is someone who can raise the khumrah (a small prayer mat or place of prostration) to him, then let him prostrate on it. If that is not possible for him, then let him gesture with his head in the direction of the qiblah by indication.” I asked: “And what about fasting?” Imam (a.s) said: “If he has reached that condition, then Allah (swt) has lifted the obligation from him. But if he is able, then giving in charity a mudd of food in place of each day is more beloved to me. And if he does not have the means for that, then there is nothing upon him.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلطَّيَالِسِيِّ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ اَلْكَرْخِيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ رَجُلٌ شَيْخٌ لاَ يَسْتَطِيعُ اَلْقِيَامَ إِلَى اَلْخَلاَءِ وَ لاَ يُمْكِنُهُ اَلرُّكُوعُ وَ اَلسُّجُودُ فَقَالَ« لِيُومِ بِرَأْسِهِ إِيمَاءً وَ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ مَنْ يَرْفَعُ اَلْخُمْرَةَ إِلَيْهِ فَلْيَسْجُدْ فَإِنْ لَمْ يُمْكِنْهُ ذَلِكَ فَلْيُومِ بِرَأْسِهِ نَحْوَ اَلْقِبْلَةِ إِيمَاءً» قُلْتُ فَالصِّيَامُ قَالَ« فَإِذَا كَانَ فِي ذَلِكَ اَلْحَدِّ فَقَدْ وَضَعَ اَللَّهُ عَنْهُ فَإِنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ مَقْدُرَةٌ فَصَدَقَةُ مُدٍّ مِنْ طَعَامٍ بَدَلَ كُلِّ يَوْمٍ أَحَبُّ إِلَيَّ وَ إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَهُ يَسَارُ ذَلِكَ فَلاَ شَيْءَ عَلَيْهِ»

items.e: Sa’ad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma'il ibn Bazi' from Tha'labah ibn Maymun from Hammad ibn Uthman from Abdurrahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “One does not perform the obligatory prayer on a riding animal except a sick person, who faces the qiblah with it, and Surah al-Fatihah suffices him. For the obligatory prayer, he should place his face on whatever he is able to from anything, and in the supererogatory prayer, he gestures by indication (ima'a).”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ ثَعْلَبَةَ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« لاَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلدَّابَّةِ اَلْفَرِيضَةَ إِلاَّ مَرِيضٌ يَسْتَقْبِلُ بِهِ اَلْقِبْلَةَ وَ يُجْزِيهِ فَاتِحَةُ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ يَضَعُ بِوَجْهِهِ فِي اَلْفَرِيضَةِ عَلَى مَا أَمْكَنَهُ مِنْ شَيْءٍ وَيُومِئُ فِي اَلنَّافِلَةِ إِيمَاءً»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn Ahmad ibn Ashyam from Mansur ibn Hazim who said: Ahmad ibn al-Nu'man asked Imam (a.s), saying: “I pray in my litter (mahmil) while I am ill” Imam (a.s) said: “As for the supererogatory prayer, then yes (it is allowed); but as for the obligatory prayer, then no.” He (Mansur) said: “And Ahmad mentioned the severity of his pain, so he said: ‘I was severely ill, and I used to instruct them when the time of prayer arrived to make the camel kneel for me, and I would be carried on my bed and placed down, and I would pray. Then I would be carried on my bed and placed back in my litter’.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَشْيَمَ عَنْ مَنْصُورِ بْنِ حَازِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلَهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ اَلنُّعْمَانِ فَقَالَ أُصَلِّي فِي مَحْمِلِي وَ أَنَا مَرِيضٌ قَالَ فَقَالَ« أَمَّا اَلنَّافِلَةُ فَنَعَمْ وَ أَمَّا اَلْفَرِيضَةُ فَلاَ» قَالَ وَ ذَكَرَ أَحْمَدُ شِدَّةَ وَجَعِهِ فَقَالَ أَنَا كُنْتُ مَرِيضاً شَدِيدَ اَلْمَرَضِ فَكُنْتُ آمُرُهُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَتِ اَلصَّلاَةُ يُنِيخُوا بِي فَأُحْتَمَلُ بِفِرَاشِي فَأُوضَعُ فَأُصَلِّي ثُمَّ أُحْتَمَلُ بِفِرَاشِي فَأُوضَعُ فِي مَحْمِلِي

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Hilal from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Abdullah ibn Sinan who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “May a man perform any of the obligatory prayers while riding?” Imam (a.s) said: “No, except out of necessity.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ هِلاَلٍ عَنْ يُونُسَ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَ يُصَلِّي اَلرَّجُلُ شَيْئاً مِنَ اَلْفُرُوضِ رَاكِباً فَقَالَ« لاَ إِلاَّ مِنْ ضَرُورَةٍ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ali ibn Sulayman who said: I wrote to Imam al-Hadi (a.s), peace be upon him, asking him: “What do you say about the tasbih prayer in the litter (mahmil)?” So Imam (a.s) wrote back: “If you are traveling, then pray (in the mahmil).”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ سُلَيْمَانَ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى اَلرَّجُلِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ مَا تَقُولُ فِي صَلاَةِ اَلتَّسْبِيحِ فِي اَلْمَحْمِلِ فَكَتَبَ« إِذَا كُنْتَ مُسَافِراً فَصَلِّ»

items.e: Sa’ad from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Ibn Abi Umayr from Dharih ibn Muhammad al-Muharibi who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the ‘Prayer of Ja’far’, may I count it from my supererogatory prayers (nafilah)? Imam (a.s) said: “Whenever you wish, by night or by day.”
items.o: سَعْدٌ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ ذَرِيحِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ اَلْمُحَارِبِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ جَعْفَرٍ أَحْتَسِبُ بِهَا مِنْ نَافِلَتِي فَقَالَ« مَا شِئْتَ مِنْ لَيْلٍ أَوْ نَهَارٍ»

items.e: From him, from Abdullah ibn Ja’far from Ali ibn al-Rayyan who said: I wrote to the last (Imam al-Hadi (a.s)), peace be upon him, asking Imam (a.s): “About a man who performs two rak‘ahs of the ‘Prayer of Ja’far’, then is hurried by a need or interrupted by an incident from completing the final two rak‘ahs. Is it permissible for him to complete it after he finishes his need, even if he stood up from his place, or is it not counted unless he begins the prayer anew and performs all four rak‘ahs in one sitting?” So Imam (a.s) wrote: “Yes, if something unavoidable interrupts him from that, then let him interrupt it, then return and build upon what remains of it, Allah (swt) willing.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلرَّيَّانِ قَالَ: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى اَلْمَاضِي اَلْأَخِيرِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَسْأَلُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ صَلَّى صَلاَةَ جَعْفَرٍ رَكْعَتَيْنِ ثُمَّ يُعَجِّلُهُ عَنِ اَلرَّكْعَتَيْنِ اَلْأَخِيرَتَيْنِ حَاجَةٌ أَوْ يَقْطَعُ ذَلِكَ بِحَادِثٍ أَ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يُتِمَّهَا إِذَا فَرَغَ مِنْ حَاجَتِهِ وَ إِنْ قَامَ عَنْ مَجْلِسِهِ أَمْ لاَ يَحْتَسِبُ ذَلِكَ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَسْتَأْنِفَ اَلصَّلاَةَ وَ يُصَلِّيَ اَلْأَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ كُلَّهَا فِي مَقَامٍ وَاحِدٍ فَكَتَبَ« بَلَى إِنْ قَطَعَهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ أَمْرٌ لاَ بُدَّ مِنْهُ فَلْيَقْطَعْ ذَلِكَ ثُمَّ لْيَرْجِعْ فَلْيَبْنِ عَلَى مَا بَقِيَ مِنْهَا إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Zurarah from Isa ibn Abdullah from his father from his grandfather from Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam Ali (a.s) said: “Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, has said: ‘Indeed, My servant seeks guidance from Me (azj) (performs istikhara), so I choose what is best for him, yet he becomes angry.’” (Hadith Qudsi)
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ عِيسَى بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ عَنْ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« قَالَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ« إِنَّ عَبْدِي يَسْتَخِيرُنِي فَأَخِيرُ لَهُ فَيَغْضَبُ»»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from Isma'il ibn Abi Ziyad from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: “No servant appoints over his family a guardianship, better than two rak‘ahs that he performs when he intends to travel. And he suplicates: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I entrust to You (azj) my self, my family, my wealth, my religion, my worldly life, my Hereafter, my trust, and the ends of my deeds’, except that Allah (swt) grants him what he asks.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ اِبْنِ أَبِي زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ:« مَا اِسْتَخْلَفَ عَبْدٌ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ بِخِلاَفَةٍ أَفْضَلَ مِنْ رَكْعَتَيْنِ يَرْكَعُهُمَا إِذَا أَرَادَ سَفَراً وَ يَقُولُ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ نَفْسِي وَ أَهْلِي وَ مَالِي وَ دِينِي وَ دُنْيَايَ وَ آخِرَتِي وَ أَمَانَتِي وَ خَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِي إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ اَللَّهُ مَا سَأَلَ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ali ibn Mahbub from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddal from his father from al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm from Abu Ali from al-Yasa‘ al-Qummi who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “I desire something and I seek guidance from Allah (swt) (perform istikhara) about it, but no clarity comes to mind regarding it, should I do it or leave it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Observe when you stand for prayer, for Satan is furthest from the human being when he stands for prayer. So observe what settles in your heart, and act upon it. And open the Mushaf and look at the first thing you see in it act upon it, if Allah (swt), the Exalted, wills.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ اَلْجَهْمِ عَنْ أَبِي عَلِيٍّ عَنِ اَلْيَسَعِ اَلْقُمِّيِّ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أُرِيدُ اَلشَّيْءَ فَأَسْتَخِيرُ اَللَّهَ فِيهِ فَلاَ يُوفَقُ فِيهِ اَلرَّأْيُ أَفْعَلُهُ أَوْ أَدَعُهُ فَقَالَ« اُنْظُرْ إِذَا قُمْتَ إِلَى اَلصَّلاَةِ فَإِنَّ اَلشَّيْطَانَ أَبْعَدُ مَا يَكُونُ مِنَ اَلْإِنْسَانِ إِذَا قَامَ إِلَى اَلصَّلاَةِ فَانْظُرْ إِلَى شَيْءٍ يَقَعُ فِي قَلْبِكَ فَخُذْ بِهِ وَ اِفْتَحِ اَلْمُصْحَفَ فَانْظُرْ إِلَى أَوَّلِ مَا تَرَى فِيهِ فَخُذْ بِهِ إِنْ شَاءَ اَللَّهُ تَعَالَى»

items.e: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Muthanna al-Hannat from Abu Basir who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “Whoever prays four rak‘ahs with two hundred recitations of ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas); fifty times in each rak‘ah, will not finish the prayer while there remains between him and Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, a single sin except that it is forgiven for him.”
items.o: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ مُثَنًّى اَلْحَنَّاطِ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ: «مَنْ صَلَّى أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ بِمِائَتَيْ مَرَّةٍ قُلْ هُوَ اَللَّهُ أَحَدٌ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ خَمْسِينَ مَرَّةً لَمْ يَنْفَتِلْ وَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ذَنْبٌ إِلاَّ غُفِرَ لَهُ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Yahya, by his chain of transmission, raised it to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Whoever prays two rak‘ahs with ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas) recited sixty times in each rak‘ah, will finish the prayer and there will remain no sin between him and Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى بِإِسْنَادِهِ رَفَعَهُ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «مَنْ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ بِ«قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ سِتِّينَ مَرَّةً اِنْفَتَلَ وَ لَيْسَ بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ ذَنْبٌ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Muhammad from some of our companions from Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Ridha (a.s) said: “Whoever prays Maghrib and after it prays four rak‘ahs and does not speak until he completes ten rak‘ahs, reciting in each rak‘ah ‘al-Hamd’ (Surah al-Fatihah) and ‘Qul huwa Allahu Ahad’ (Surah Ikhlas), it will be equal to the freeing of ten slaves.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ صَلَّى اَلْمَغْرِبَ وَ بَعْدَهَا أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ وَ لَمْ يَتَكَلَّمْ حَتَّى يُصَلِّيَ عَشْرَ رَكَعَاتٍ يَقْرَأُ فِي كُلِّ رَكْعَةٍ بِالْحَمْدِ وَ« قُلْ هُوَ اَللّٰهُ أَحَدٌ» كَانَتْ عِدْلَ عَشْرِ رِقَابٍ»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Faddal, who said: Al-Hasan ibn al-Jahm asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, on behalf of Ibn Asbat, and said to Imam (a.s): “What do you see for him (Ibn Asbat)?”, while Ibn Asbat was present and we were all intending to travel by sea or land to Egypt, and he informed Imam (a.s) about the land route. So Imam (a.s) said: “Go to the mosque at a time other than the time of an obligatory prayer, and pray two rak‘ahs, and seek guidance from Allah (swt) (perform istikhara) one hundred times, then see what settles in your heart, and act upon it.” And al-Hasan said to Imam (a.s): “The land route is more beloved to me.” Imam (a.s) said: “And to me as well.”
items.o: احمد بن محمد عن ابن فضال قال سأل الحسن بن الجهم ابا الحسن الرضا عليه السلام لابن أسباط فقال له ما ترى له وابن أسباط حاضر ونحن جميعا نركب البحر أو البر إلى مصر وأخبره بخبر طريق البر فقال إئت المسجد في غر وقت صلاة فريضة فصل ركعتين واستخر الله مائة مرة ثم انظر أي شئ يقع في قلبك فاعمل به وقال له الحسن البر أحب إلي قال وإلي

items.e: Muhammad ibn Isma'il by al-Fadl ibn Shadhan by Safwan from Ibn Muskan by Muhammad ibn Ali al-Halabi: A man complained to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, of poverty and hardship in trade after having previously been in ease, that whenever he set out for something, his livelihood became constrained. So Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, instructed him to go to the standing place of the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, between His (saws) grave and the pulpit, and to perform two rak‘ahs and to say one hundred times: “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by Your strength, by Your power, by Your might, and by that which Your knowledge encompasses, to ease for me the most abundant in provision, the most encompassing in bounty, and the best in outcome of trades.” The man said: “So I did what Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, commanded me to do, and thereafter I never set out in any direction except that Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, provided for me.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ شَاذَانَ عَنْ صَفْوَانَ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ قَالَ: شَكَا رَجُلٌ إِلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ اَلْفَاقَةَ وَاَلْحُرْفَةَ فِي اَلتِّجَارَةِ بَعْدَ يَسَارٍ قَدْ كَانَ فِيهِ مَا يَتَوَجَّهُ فِي حَاجَةٍ إِلاَّ ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِ اَلْمَعِيشَةُ فَأَمَرَهُ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ أَنْ يَأْتِيَ مَقَامَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ بَيْنَ اَلْقَبْرِ وَ اَلْمِنْبَرِ فَيُصَلِّيَ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ يَقُولَ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ« اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِقُوَّتِكَ وَ بِقُدْرَتِكَ وَ بِعِزَّتِكَ وَ مَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ عِلْمُكَ أَنْ تُيَسِّرَ لِي مِنَ اَلتِّجَارَةِ أَسْبَغَهَا رِزْقاً وَ أَعَمَّهَا فَضْلاً وَ خَيْرَهَا عَاقِبَةً» قَالَ اَلرَّجُلُ فَفَعَلْتُ مَا أَمَرَنِي بِهِ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَمَا تَوَجَّهْتُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ فِي وَجْهٍ إِلاَّ رَزَقَنِيَ اَللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ahmad ibn Abi Dawud from Ibn Abi Hamzah from Abu Ja’far (a.s), who said: A man came to Imam al-Ridha (a.s), peace be upon him, and said to him: “O’ son of the Messenger of Allah (swt), I have dependents and I am in debt, and my condition has become severe, so teach me a supplication which, if I supplicate to Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, with it, He (azj) will provide for me.” Imam (a.s) said: “O servant of Allah (swt), perform ablution and perfect your ablution, then pray two rak‘ahs, completing the bowing and prostration in them. Then say; ‘O’ Majid, O’ Generous, O’ One, O’ Generous, I turn to You (azj) by (Prophet) Muhammad (saws), Your Prophet, the Prophet of mercy. O’ Muhammad (saws), O’ Messenger of Allah (swt), I turn through you to Allah (swt), your Lord (azj) and the Lord (azj) of all things, that He (azj) may send blessings upon (Prophet) Muhammad (saws) and upon the family of his household, and I ask You (azj) for a breath of Your mercy, an easy opening, and a vast provision by which I may gather my scattered state, settle my debt, and seek help through it for my dependents’.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ أَبِي دَاوُدَ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ إِلَى اَلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَقَالَ لَهُ يَا اِبْنَ رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ إِنِّي ذُو عِيَالٍ وَ عَلَيَّ دَيْنٌ وَ قَدِ اِشْتَدَّتْ حَالِي فَعَلِّمْنِي دُعَاءً إِذَا دَعَوْتُ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِهِ رَزَقَنِيَ اَللَّهُ فَقَالَ« يَا عَبْدَ اَللَّهِ تَوَضَّأْ وَ أَسْبِغْ وُضُوءَكَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ تُتِمُّ اَلرُّكُوعَ وَ اَلسُّجُودَ فِيهِمَا ثُمَّ قُلْ يَا مَاجِدُ يَا كَرِيمُ يَا وَاحِدُ يَا كَرِيمُ أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِمُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّكَ نَبِيِّ اَلرَّحْمَةِ يَا مُحَمَّدُ يَارَسُولَ اَللَّهِ إِنِّي أَتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَى اَللَّهِ رَبِّكَ وَ رَبِّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ أَنْ تُصَلِّيَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ أَسْأَلُكَ نَفْحَةً مِنْ نَفَحَاتِكَ وَ فَتْحاً يَسِيراً وَ رِزْقاً وَاسِعاً أَلُمُّ بِهِ شَعْثِي وَ أَقْضِي بِهِ دَيْنِي وَ أَسْتَعِينُ بِهِ عَلَى عِيَالِي»

items.e: From him, from Ibn Abi Najran from Sabbah al-Hadhdha’ from Abu al-Tayyar who said: I said to Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “There was something in my possession but it was lost and I fell into great distress because of it.” Imam (a.s) said to me: “Do you have a shop in the market?” I said: “Yes, but I have left it.” Imam (a.s) said: “When you return to Kufa, sit in your shop and sweep it. And when you intend to go out to your marketplace, then pray two or four rak‘ahs, then say at the end of your prayer: ‘I turn with no power or strength from myself, but with Your power, O’ Lord (azj), and Your strength. I disassociate from any power and strength except through You (azj). So You (azj) are my strength, and from You (azj) is my power. O’ Allah (swt), provide me from Your vast bounty a plentiful, good provision while I remain in ease and well-being, for none possesses it besides You (azj).” He (Abu al-Tayyar) said: “So I did that, and I would go out to my shop until I feared that the tax collector would seize me, for the rent of my shop, while I had nothing. Then a merchant came with goods and said to me: ‘Will you rent me half of your house?’ So I rented him half of my house for the (amount equal to) rent of the whole house. Then he (the merchant) showed me his merchandise, and someone offered him a price for it but he did not sell it. So I (Abu al-Tayyar) said to him (the merchant): “Would you like something better? Sell me a bundle of your goods, and I will sell it and take the profit and return to you its price.” He (the merchant) said: “How can I trust you with that?” I (Abu al-Tayyar) said: “You have my oath to Allah (swt) for that.” So he (the merchant) said: “Take a bundle of it.” So I took it, marked it, and a severe cold came, and I sold the goods that same day. I gave him his price and took the profit. I continued to take a bundle, sell it, take the profit, and return to him the capital until I was able to ride animals, purchase slaves, and build houses.
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي نَجْرَانَ عَنْ صَبَّاحٍ اَلْحَذَّاءِ عَنْ أَبِي اَلطَّيَّارِ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِنَّهُ كَانَ فِي يَدِي شَيْءٌ فَتَفَرَّقَ وَ ضِقْتُ بِهِ ضَيْقاً شَدِيداً فَقَالَ لِي« أَ لَكَ حَانُوتٌ فِي اَلسُّوقِ» فَقُلْتُ نَعَمْ وَ قَدْ تَرَكْتُهُ فَقَالَ« إِذَا رَجَعْتَ إِلَى اَلْكُوفَةِ فَاقْعُدْ فِي حَانُوتِكَ وَ اُكْنُسْهُ وَ إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَنْ تَخْرُجَ إِلَى سُوقِكَ فَصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ أَوْ أَرْبَعَ رَكَعَاتٍ ثُمَّ قُلْ فِي دُبُرِ صَلاَتِكَ تَوَجَّهْتُ بِلاَ حَوْلٍ مِنِّي وَ لاَ قُوَّةٍ وَ لَكِنْ بِحَوْلِكَ يَا رَبِّ وَ قُوَّتِكَ وَ أَبْرَأُ مِنَ اَلْحَوْلِ وَاَلْقُوَّةِ إِلاَّ بِكَ فَأَنْتَ حَوْلِي وَ مِنْكَ قُوَّتِي اَللَّهُمَّ فَارْزُقْنِي مِنْ فَضْلِكَ اَلْوَاسِعِ رِزْقاً كَثِيراً طَيِّباً وَ أَنَا خَافِضٌ فِي عَافِيَتِكَ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَمْلِكُهَا أَحَدٌ غَيْرُكَ» قَالَ فَفَعَلْتُ ذَلِكَ وَ كُنْتُ أَخْرُجُ إِلَى دُكَّانِي حَتَّى خِفْتُ أَنْ يَأْخُذَنِي اَلْجَابِي بِأُجْرَةِ دُكَّانِي وَ مَا عِنْدِي شَيْءٌ قَالَ فَجَاءَ جَالِبٌ بِمَتَاعٍ فَقَالَ لِي تُكْرِينِي نِصْفَ بَيْتِكَ فَأَكْرَيْتُهُ نِصْفَ بَيْتِي بِكِرَى اَلْبَيْتِ كُلِّهِ قَالَ وَ عَرَضَ عَلَيَّ مَتَاعَهُ فَأُعْطِي بِهِ شَيْئاً لَمْ يَبِعْهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ هَلْ لَكَ إِلَى خَيْرٍ تَبِيعُنِي عِدْلاً مِنْ مَتَاعِكَ هَذَا أَبِيعُهُ وَ آخُذُ فَضْلَهُ وَ أَدْفَعُ إِلَيْكَ ثَمَنَهُ قَالَ فَكَيْفَ لِي بِذَلِكَ قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ لَكَ اَللَّهُ عَلَيَّ بِذَلِكَ قَالَ فَخُذْ عِدْلاً مِنْهَا فَأَخَذْتُهُ وَ رَقَمْتُهُ وَ جَاءَ بَرْدٌ شَدِيدٌ فَبِعْتُ اَلْمَتَاعَ مِنْ يَوْمِي وَ دَفَعْتُ إِلَيْهِ اَلثَّمَنَ وَ أَخَذْتُ اَلْفَضْلَ فَمَا زِلْتُ آخُذُ عِدْلاً وَ أَبِيعُهُ وَ آخُذُ فَضْلَهُ وَ أَرُدُّ عَلَيْهِ رَأْسَ اَلْمَالِ حَتَّى رَكِبْتُ اَلدَّوَابَّ وَ اِشْتَرَيْتُ اَلرَّقِيقَ وَ بَنَيْتُ اَلدُّورَ

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Abdillah from Ibrahim ibn Ishaq from Abdullah ibn Ahmad from al-Hasan ibn Uruwah, the nephew of Shu'ayb al-Aqarqufi, from his uncle Shu'ayb who said: Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: “Whoever feels hunger, let him perform ablution, and let him pray two rak‘ahs, completing their bowing and prostration, and say: ‘O’ Lord (azj), I am hungry, so feed me’, for indeed he will be fed immediately.”
items.o: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَعْقُوبَ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ اِبْنِ أُخْتِ شُعَيْبٍ اَلْعَقَرْقُوفِيِّ عَنْ خَالِهِ شُعَيْبٍ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« مَنْ جَاعَ فَلْيَتَوَضَّأْ وَ لْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ يُتِمُّ رُكُوعَهُمَا وَ سُجُودَهُمَا وَ يَقُولُ يَا رَبِّ إِنِّي جَائِعٌ فَأَطْعِمْنِي فَإِنَّهُ يُطْعَمُ مِنْ سَاعَتِهِ»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahbub from al-Hasan ibn Salih who said: I heard Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “Whoever performs ablution and perfects the ablution, and then prays two rak‘ahs, completing their bowing and prostration, then sits and praises Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, and sends blessings upon the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and then asks Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, for his need; Then indeed he has sought goodness in its proper place. And whoever seeks goodness in its proper place will not be disappointed.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ صَالِحٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ اَلْوُضُوءَ وَ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ أَتَمَّ رُكُوعَهُمَا وَ سُجُودَهُمَا ثُمَّ جَلَسَ فَأَثْنَى عَلَى اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ صَلَّى عَلَى رَسُولِ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ ثُمَّ سَأَلَ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ حَاجَتَهُ فَقَدْ طَلَبَ اَلْخَيْرَ فِي مَظَانِّهِ وَ مَنْ طَلَبَ اَلْخَيْرَ فِي مَظَانِّهِ لَمْ يَخِبْ»

items.e: From him, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from Abdullah ibn Uthman, from Abu Isma'il al-Sarraj, from Abdullah ibn Waddah and Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Isma'il ibn al-Arqat and his mother Umm Salamah, the sister of Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: I (Isma'il ibn al-Arqat) fell severely ill during the Month of Ramadan, to the point that I was near death, and the Banu Hashim gathered at night for the funeral, believing that I was dead. My mother (Umm Salamah) became distressed over me, so Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, my maternal uncle, said to her: “Go up to the roof of the house, face the sky, and pray two rak‘ahs. When you finish the prayer with the salam, then say; ‘O’ Allah (swt), You (azj) granted him to me when he was nothing. O’ Allah (swt), I now ask You (azj) to grant him to me anew so lend him to me.’” He (Isma'il ibn al-Arqat) said: “So she did that, and I regained consciousness and sat up, and they brought suhur for themselves harisah, and they ate it for suhur, and I ate with them.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ اَلسَّرَّاجِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ وَضَّاحٍ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ اَلْأَرْقَطِ وَ أُمُّهُ أُمُّ سَلَمَةَ أُخْتُ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: مَرِضْتُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ مَرَضاً شَدِيداً حَتَّى تَلِفْتُ وَ اِجْتَمَعَتْ بَنُو هَاشِمٍ لَيْلاً لِلْجَنَازَةِ وَ هُمْ يَرَوْنَ أَنِّي مَيِّتٌ فَجَزِعَتْ أُمِّي عَلَيَّ فَقَالَ لَهَا أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ خَالِي« اِصْعَدِي إِلَى فَوْقِ اَلْبَيْتِ فَابْرُزِي إِلَى اَلسَّمَاءِ وَ صَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا سَلَّمْتِ فَقُولِي اَللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ وَهَبْتَهُ لِي وَ لَمْ يَكُ شَيْئاً اَللَّهُمَّ وَ إِنِّي اِسْتَوْهَبْتُكَهُ مُبْتَدِئاً فَأَعِرْنِيهِ» قَالَ فَفَعَلَتْ فَأَفَقْتُ وَ قَعَدْتُ وَ دَعَوْا بِسَحُورٍ لَهُمْ هَرِيسَةٍ فَتَسَحَّرُوا بِهَا وَ تَسَحَّرْتُ مَعَهُمْ

items.e: And with this chain of transmission, from Abu Ismail al-Sarraj, from Ibn Muskan, from Shurahbil al-Kindi, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “If you desire a matter for which you ask your Lord (azj), then perform ablution and perfect the ablution, then pray two units of prayer, And magnify Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, And send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, And say after the taslim (salutation at the end of prayer): “O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by the fact that You (azj) are a noble King, And that You (azj) have power over all things, And that You (azj), over whatever You (azj) will of a matter, it ‘becomes’. O’ Allah (swt), I turn to You (azj) by Your Prophet Muhammad (saws), the Prophet of mercy, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. O’ Muhammad (saws), O’ Messenger of Allah (swt), indeed I turn through you to Allah (swt), your Lord (azj) and my Lord (azj), that He (azj) may fulfill through you my request. O’ Allah (swt), by Your Prophet (saws), fulfill for me my request, by Muhammad (saws).” Then you ask for your need.
items.o: وَ بِهَذَا اَلْإِسْنَادِ عَنْ أَبِي إِسْمَاعِيلَ اَلسَّرَّاجِ عَنِ اِبْنِ مُسْكَانَ عَنْ شُرَحْبِيلَ اَلْكِنْدِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «إِذَا أَرَدْتَ أَمْراً تَسْأَلُهُ رَبَّكَ فَتَوَضَّأْ وَ أَحْسِنِ اَلْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ وَ عَظِّمِ اَللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ صَلِّ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ قُلْ بَعْدَ اَلتَّسْلِيمِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِأَنَّكَ مَلِكٌ كَرِيمٌ وَ أَنَّكَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ مُقْتَدِرٌ وَ أَنَّكَ عَلَى مَا تَشَاءُ مِنْ أَمْرٍ يَكُنِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَوَجَّهُ إِلَيْكَ بِنَبِيِّكَ مُحَمَّدٍ نَبِيِّ اَلرَّحْمَةِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ يَا مُحَمَّدُ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ إِنِّي أَتَوَجَّهُ بِكَ إِلَى اَللَّهِ رَبِّكَ وَ رَبِّي لِيُنْجِحَ لِي بِكَ طَلِبَتِي اَللَّهُمَّ بِنَبِيِّكَ أَنْجِحْ لِي طَلِبَتِي بِمُحَمَّدٍ» ثُمَّ تَسْأَلُ حَاجَتَكَ.

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahb from Zurarah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq said regarding a matter, which a seeker asks from his Lord (azj). Imam (a.s) said: “Give charity during your day to sixty needy persons, to each needy person, a sa’ (a unit of measure). This is according to the sa’ of the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family. Then when the night comes, perform ghusl (ritual bathing) in the last third (of the night), and wear the lowest (humblest) of what those whom you support, wear of clothing, except that upon those clothes, you must have a waist-wrapper (izar). Then pray two units of prayer, and when you place your forehead in the final prostration (sajdah) for sujud, glorify Allah (swt) (hallilta), exalt Him (azj) (‘azzamta-hu), sanctify Him (azj) (qaddasta-hu), and praise Him (azj) (majjadta-hu), and you mention your sins, and you confess what you know of them by name. Then you raise your head. Then when you place your head for the second prostration, seek guidance from Allah (swt) one hundred times; ‘O’ Allah (swt), I seek guidance from You (azj)’ Then you supplicate to Allah (swt) with whatever you wish, then you ask Him (azj). And whenever you prostrate, let your knees rest on the ground, then raise the izar until you uncover them (the knees), and place the izar behind you between your buttocks and the inner part of your thighs.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ بْنِ وَهْبٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ: فِي اَلْأَمْرِ يَطْلُبُهُ اَلطَّالِبُ مِنْ رَبِّهِ قَالَ« تَصَدَّقْ فِي يَوْمِكَ عَلَى سِتِّينَ مِسْكِيناً عَلَى كُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ صَاعٌ بِصَاعِ اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ فَإِذَا كَانَ اَللَّيْلُ اِغْتَسَلْتَ فِي اَلثُّلُثِ اَلْبَاقِي وَ لَبِسْتَ أَدْنَى مَا يَلْبَسُ مَنْ تَعُولُ مِنَ اَلثِّيَابِ إِلاَّ أَنَّ عَلَيْكَ فِي تِلْكَ اَلثِّيَابِ إِزَاراً ثُمَّ تُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ فَإِذَا وَضَعْتَ جَبْهَتَكَ فِي اَلسَّجْدَةِ اَلْأَخِيرَةِ لِلسُّجُودِ هَلَّلْتَ اَللَّهَ وَ عَظَّمْتَهُ وَ قَدَّسْتَهُ وَ مَجَّدْتَهُ وَ ذَكَرْتَ ذُنُوبَكَ فَأَقْرَرْتَ بِمَا تَعْرِفُ مِنْهَا مُسَمًّى ثُمَّ رَفَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ ثُمَّ إِذَا وَضَعْتَ رَأْسَكَ لِلسَّجْدَةِ اَلثَّانِيَةِ فَاسْتَخَرْتَ اَللَّهَ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْتَخِيرُكَ ثُمَّ تَدْعُو اَللَّهَ بِمَا شِئْتَ ثُمَّ تَسْأَلُهُ وَ كُلَّمَا سَجَدْتَ فَأَفْضِ بِرُكْبَتَيْكَ إِلَى اَلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ تَرْفَعُ اَلْإِزَارَ حَتَّى تَكْشِفَهُمَا وَ اِجْعَلِ اَلْإِزَارَ مِنْ خَلْفِكَ بَيْنَ أَلْيَيْكَ وَ بَاطِنِ سَاقَيْكَ»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from al-Washsha’ from Aban from Hariz from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “Establish a place of prayer in your house, and if you fear something, then wear two thick garments from the thickest of your clothes, and pray in them. Then kneel on your knees and cry out to Allah (swt), Mighty and Majestic, and ask Him (azj) for Paradise, and seek refuge with Allah (swt) from the evil of what you fear. And beware lest Allah (swt) hears from you a single word of transgression (baghy), even if your soul and your clan please you.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اَلْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ حَرِيزٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اِتَّخِذْ مَسْجِداً فِي بَيْتِكَ فَإِذَا خِفْتَ شَيْئاً فَالْبَسْ ثَوْبَيْنِ غَلِيظَيْنِ مِنْ أَغْلَظِ ثِيَابِكَ فَصَلِّ فِيهِمَا ثُمَّ اُجْثُ عَلَى رُكْبَتَيْكَ فَاصْرُخْ إِلَى اَللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ سَلْهُ اَلْجَنَّةَ وَ تَعَوَّذْ بِاللَّهِ مِنْ شَرِّ اَلَّذِي تَخَافُهُ وَ إِيَّاكَ أَنْ يَسْمَعَ اَللَّهُ مِنْكَ كَلِمَةَ بَغْيٍ وَ إِنْ أَعْجَبَتْكَ نَفْسَكَ وَ عَشِيرَتَكَ»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from a man from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Whoever desires that conception (pregnancy) be granted to him, let him pray two units of prayer after Jumu‘ah (Friday prayer), prolonging the bowing (ruku‘) and the prostration (sujud) in them. Then let him say: ‘O’ Allah (swt), I ask You (azj) by what Zakariyya (a.s) asked You (azj) when he said: ‘My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors’. (Surah Al Anbiya 21:89) O’ Allah (swt), grant me ‘good offspring; indeed, You are the Hearer of supplication’. (Surah Aal Imran 3:38) O’ Allah (swt), by Your name I have made her lawful, and by Your trust I have taken her (as a wife), so if You decree in her womb a child, then make him a boy, and do not make for Satan any share or partnership in him’.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلْحَكَمِ عَنْ رَجُلٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« مَنْ أَرَادَ أَنْ يُحْبَلَ لَهُ فَلْيُصَلِّ رَكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ اَلْجُمُعَةِ يُطِيلُ فِيهِمَا اَلرُّكُوعَ وَ اَلسُّجُودَ ثُمَّ يَقُولُ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ بِمَا سَأَلَكَ بِهِ زَكَرِيَّا إِذْ قَالَ« رَبِّ لاٰ تَذَرْنِي فَرْداً وَ أَنْتَ خَيْرُ اَلْوٰارِثِينَ» اَللَّهُمَّ هَبْ لِي« ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ اَلدُّعٰاءِ» اَللَّهُمَّ بِاسْمِكَ اِسْتَحْلَلْتُهَا وَ بِأَمَانَتِكَ أَخَذْتُهَا فَإِنْ قَضَيْتَ فِي رَحِمِهَا وَلَداً فَاجْعَلْهُ غُلاَماً وَ لاَ تَجْعَلْ لِلشَّيْطَانِ فِيهِ نَصِيباً وَ لاَ شِرْكاً»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Fadalah from Kulayb al-Asadi said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbir (declaration of ‘Allahu Akbar’) over the deceased. Imam (a.s) gestured with his hand five times. I asked: “Then what should I say when I pray over him?” Imam (a.s) said: “You say; ‘O’ Allah (swt), Your servant has become in need of Your mercy, and You are free of any need to punish him. O’ Allah (swt), if he was a doer of good, then increase his good deeds, and if he was a wrongdoer, then forgive him’.”
items.o: اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ كُلَيْبٍ اَلْأَسَدِيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ بِيَدِهِ خَمْساً قُلْتُ فَكَيْفَ أَقُولُ إِذَا صَلَّيْتُ عَلَيْهِ قَالَ تَقُولُ« اَللَّهُمَّ عَبْدُكَ اِحْتَاجَ إِلَى رَحْمَتِكَ وَ أَنْتَ غَنِيٌّ عَنْ عَذَابِهِ اَللَّهُمَّ إِنْ كَانَ مُحْسِناً فَزِدْ فِي إِحْسَانِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ مُسِيئاً فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ»
items.h: Chapter on the Prayer over the Dead

items.e: From him, from Fadalah, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« اَلتَّكْبِيرُ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ»

items.e: From him, from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, from Abu Ja’far (a.s): Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced five takbirs (over the deceased).”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ« كَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ خَمْساً»

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdullah from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali from Hammad ibn Muhammad from Shu‘ayb from Abu Basir from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.”
items.o: سعد بن عبد الله عن ابراهيم بن مهزيار عن اخيه علي عن حماد بن محمد عن شعيب عن ابي بصير عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال التكبير على الميت خمس تكبيرات

items.e: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ali ibn al-Salt from Abdullah ibn al-Salt from al-Hasan ibn Ali from Ibn Bukayr from Qudamah ibn Zaydah who said: I heard Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, say: “Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed (Salat Al Mayyit) over his son Ibrahim (a.s), peace be upon him, and He (saws) pronounced five takbirs over him.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ عَلِيِّ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ عَنِ اِبْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ قُدَامَةَ بْنِ زَائِدَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ يَقُولُ:« إِنَّ رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ صَلَّى عَلَى اِبْنِهِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً»

items.e: Abdullah ibn al-Salt from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub from Abu Walad who said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbirs over the deceased. Imam (a.s) said: “Five (takbirs).”
items.o: عَبْدُ اَللَّهِ بْنُ اَلصَّلْتِ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ أَبِي وَلاَّدٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فَقَالَ« خَمْساً»

items.e: As for what was narrated by Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Khalid al-Barqi from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr al-Khazzaz from ‘Amr ibn Shimr from Jabir, who said: I asked Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, about the takbir over the funeral, is there something fixed (in number) in it or not? Imam (a.s) said: “No. The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, pronounced eleven, nine, seven, five, six, and four takbirs (over the deceased).”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ خَالِدٍ اَلْبَرْقِيِّ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ اَلْخَزَّازِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ هَلْ فِيهِ شَيْءٌ مُوَقَّتٌ أَمْ لاَ فَقَالَ« لاَ كَبَّرَ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ أَحَدَ عَشَرَ وَ تِسْعاً وَ سَبْعاً وَ خَمْساً وَ سِتّاً وَ أَرْبَعاً»

items.e: Al-Husayn ibn Sa’id from Muhammad ibn Abi ‘Umayr from Hammad ibn Uthman and Hisham ibn Salim from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, used to pronounce five takbirs (of Salat Al Mayyit) over some people and four over others. So if He (saws) pronounced four takbirs over a man, he would be regarded with suspicion.” (meaning it was commanded to Prophet (saws) to recite four takbir over the deceased hypocrites)
items.o: الحسين بن سعيد عن محمد بن ابي عمير عن حماد بن عثمان وهشام بن سالم عن ابي عبد الله عليه السلام قال كان رسول الله صلى الله عليه وآله يكبر على قوم خمسا وعلى آخرين أربعا فإذا كبر على رجل أربعا اتهم

items.e: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Abdullah ibn Ja’far from Ibrahim ibn Mahziyar from his brother Ali from Isma’il ibn Hammam from Abu al-Hasan (a.s), peace be upon him, who said that Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, prayed over a funeral and pronounced five takbirs over it, and He (saws) prayed over another and pronounced four takbirs over it. As for the one over whom Prophet (saws) pronounced five takbirs; He (saws) praised Allah (swt) and glorified Him (azj) in the first takbir, And in the second, He (saws) supplicated for the Prophet (saws) (himself), And in the third, He (saws) supplicated for the believing men and believing women, And in the fourth, He (saws) supplicated for the deceased, And He (saws) concluded in the fifth. As for the one over whom Prophet (saws) pronounced four takbirs; He (saws) praised Allah (swt) and glorified Him (azj) in the first takbir, And in the second, He (saws) supplicated for the himself, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and for his household, peace be upon them, And in the third, He (saws) supplicated for the believing men and believing women, And He (saws) concluded in the fourth and He (saws) did not supplicate for him, because he was a hypocrite.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مَهْزِيَارَ عَنْ أَخِيهِ عَلِيٍّ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ هَمَّامٍ عَنْ أَبِي اَلْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ:« صَلَّى رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً وَ صَلَّى عَلَى آخَرَ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعاً فَأَمَّا اَلَّذِي كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً فَحَمِدَ اَللَّهَ وَ مَجَّدَهُ فِي اَلتَّكْبِيرَةِ اَلْأُولَى وَ دَعَا فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ لِلنَّبِيِّ وَ دَعَا فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ اَلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ وَ دَعَا فِي اَلرَّابِعَةِ لِلْمَيِّتِ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ فِي اَلْخَامِسَةِ وَ أَمَّا اَلَّذِي كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ أَرْبَعاً فَحَمِدَ اَللَّهَ وَ مَجَّدَهُ فِي اَلتَّكْبِيرَةِ اَلْأُولَى وَ دَعَا لِنَفْسِهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ عَلَيهِمُ اَلسَّلاَمُ فِي اَلثَّانِيَةِ وَ دَعَا لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَ اَلْمُؤْمِنَاتِ فِي اَلثَّالِثَةِ وَ اِنْصَرَفَ فِي اَلرَّابِعَةِ فَلَمْ يَدْعُ لَهُ لِأَنَّهُ كَانَ مُنَافِقاً»

items.e: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Ahmad ibn Idris from Muhammad ibn Salim from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr from ‘Amr ibn Shimr who said: I said to Imam Ja’far ibn Muhammad (a.s), peace be upon him: “May I be your ransom, we speak in Iraq that Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, prayed over Sahl ibn Hunayf and pronounced six takbirs over him, then turned to those who were behind him and said: ‘Indeed, he was a Badri (a participant in the Battle of Badr)’.” He (‘Amr ibn Shimr) said: “So Imam Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: ‘It was not so, but Imam Ali (a.s) prayed over him with five takbirs, then lifted him and walked with him for a while, then placed him down and pronounced five takbirs over him (again), And Imam (a.s) did that five times, until He (a.s) had pronounced over him twenty-five takbirs.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِجَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّا نَتَحَدَّثُ بِالْعِرَاقِ أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ صَلَّى عَلَى سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ سِتّاً ثُمَّ اِلْتَفَتَ إِلَى مَنْ كَانَ خَلْفَهُ فَقَالَ« إِنَّهُ كَانَ بَدْرِيّاً» قَالَ فَقَالَ جَعْفَرٌ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ« إِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ كَذَا وَ لَكِنَّهُ صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً ثُمَّ رَفَعَهُ وَ مَشَى بِهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ وَضَعَهُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً فَفَعَلَ ذَلِكَ خَمْسَ مَرَّاتٍ حَتَّى كَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً وَ عِشْرِينَ تَكْبِيرَةً»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa from Muhammad ibn Isma’il ibn Bazi‘ from Muhammad ibn ‘Udhafir from ‘Uqbah from Imam Ja’far (a.s), who said: Imam Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, was asked about the takbir over the funerals. Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to the family of the deceased whatever they wish, they may pronounce in takbirs.” It was said to Imam (a.s): “They (chose to) pronounce four takbirs.” Imam (a.s) said: “That is up to them.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “Has it (a report)not reached you that a man was prayed over by Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, and Imam (a.s) pronounced five takbirs over him until he prayed over him five prayers, pronouncing five takbirs in each (Salat Al Mayyit) prayer?” He (Uqbah) said: “Then Imam (a.s) said: ‘Indeed, he was a Badri, ‘Uqabi, Uhudi, and he was among the naqib (leaders) whom the Messenger of Allah (swt), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, chose from among the twelve, so he had five virtues’. Therefore, Imam Ali (a.s) prayed over him; one (Salat Al Mayyit) prayer for each virtue.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ بَزِيعٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عُذَافِرٍ عَنْ عُقْبَةَ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ: سُئِلَ جَعْفَرٌ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ« ذَاكَ إِلَى أَهْلِ اَلْمَيِّتِ مَا شَاءُوا كَبَّرُوا» فَقِيلَ إِنَّهُمْ يُكَبِّرُونَ أَرْبَعاً فَقَالَ« ذَاكَ إِلَيْهِمْ» ثُمَّ قَالَ« أَ مَا بَلَغَكُمْ أَنَّ رَجُلاً صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ عَلِيٌّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ فَكَبَّرَ عَلَيْهِ خَمْساً حَتَّى صَلَّى عَلَيْهِ خَمْسَ صَلَوَاتٍُ يُكَبِّرُ فِي كُلِّ صَلاَةٍ خَمْسَ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ» قَالَ« ثُمَّ قَالَ« إِنَّهُ بَدْرِيٌّ عَقَبِيٌّ أُحُدِيٌّ وَكَانَ مِنَ اَلنُّقَبَاءِ اَلَّذِينَ اِخْتَارَهُمْ رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ مِنَ اَلاِثْنَيْ عَشَرَ فَكَانَتْ لَهُ خَمْسُ مَنَاقِبَ» فَصَلَّى عَلَيْهِ لِكُلِّ مَنْقَبَةٍ صَلاَةً»

items.e: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Kufi, whose nickname was Hamdan, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah from Muhammad ibn Abi Hamzah from Muhammad ibn Yazid from Abu Basir who said: I was sitting with Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, when a man entered and asked Imam (a.s) about the (amount of) takbir over the funerals. Imam (a.s) said: “Five takbirs.” Then another man entered and asked Imam (a.s) about the prayer over the funerals. Imam (a.s) said to him: “Four prayers.” So the first man said: “May I be your ransom, I asked you and you said five (takbirs), and this one asked you and you said four (takbirs).” Imam (a.s) said: “You asked me about the takbirs, and this one asked me about the prayers.” Then Imam (a.s) said: “They are five takbirs, between them are four prayers.” Then Imam (a.s) opened his palm and said: “Indeed, they are five takbirs, between them are four prayers.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ اَلْكُوفِيِّ وَ لَقَبُهُ حَمْدَانُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ: كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ جَالِساً فَدَخَلَ رَجُلٌ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ« خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ» ثُمَّ دَخَلَ آخَرُ فَسَأَلَهُ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ لَهُ« أَرْبَعُ صَلَوَاتٍُ» فَقَالَ اَلْأَوَّلُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ سَأَلْتُكَ فَقُلْتَ خَمْساً وَ سَأَلَكَ هَذَا فَقُلْتَ أَرْبَعاً فَقَالَ« إِنَّكَ سَأَلْتَنِي عَنِ اَلتَّكْبِيرِ وَ سَأَلَنِي هَذَا عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ» ثُمَّ قَالَ« إِنَّهَا خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ بَيْنَهُنَّ أَرْبَعُ صَلَوَاتٍُ» ثُمَّ بَسَطَ كَفَّهُ فَقَالَ« إِنَّهُنَّ خَمْسُ تَكْبِيرَاتٍ بَيْنَهُنَّ أَرْبَعُ صَلَوَاتٍُ»

items.e: Ali ibn al-Husayn from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn from ‘Ubayys ibn Hisham from al-Hasan ibn Ahmad al-Minqari from Yunus from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The prayer over the funerals; the first takbir is the opening of the prayer, the second is to bear witness that there is ‘No God but Allah (swt)’ and that ‘(Prophet) Muhammad (saws) is the Messenger of Allah (swt)’, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, the third is the prayer upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, and upon his household, and praise of Allah (swt), the fourth is for (prayer for) him (the deceased), and the fifth is the salutation, And he (imam of prayer) stands for the amount of time between two takbirs and does not leave until the bier is lifted from in front of him (imam of prayer).”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ عُبَيْسِ بْنِ هِشَامٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ أَحْمَدَ اَلْمِنْقَرِيِّ عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ قَالَ:« اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ اَلتَّكْبِيرَةُ اَلْأُولَى اِسْتِفْتَاحُ اَلصَّلاَةِ وَ اَلثَّانِيَةُ يَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اَللَّهُ وَ أَنَّ مُحَمَّداً رَسُولُ اَللَّهِ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ اَلثَّالِثَةُ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ وَ عَلَى أَهْلِ بَيْتِهِ وَ اَلثَّنَاءُ عَلَى اَللَّهِ وَ اَلرَّابِعَةُ لَهُ وَ اَلْخَامِسَةُ يُسَلِّمُ وَ يَقِفُ مِقْدَارَ مَا بَيْنَ اَلتَّكْبِيرَتَيْنِ وَ لاَ يَبْرَحُ حَتَّى يُحْمَلَ اَلسَّرِيرُ مِنْ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ»

items.e: As for what was narrated by Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya from Ja’far ibn Muhammad from ‘Ubaydullah al-Qummi from Abdullah ibn Maymun al-Qaddah from Imam Ja’far (a.s), from his father (a.s): Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “Indeed, Imam Ali (a.s), peace be upon him, when He (a.s) prayed over a deceased person, He (a.s) would recite the ‘Fatihati al-Kitab’ (Surah al-Fatiha) and send blessings upon the Prophet (saws), may Allah (swt) bless him and his family.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ يَحْيَى عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْقُمِّيِّ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ بْنِ مَيْمُونٍ اَلْقَدَّاحِ عَنْ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَبِيهِ:« أَنَّ عَلِيّاً عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى مَيِّتٍ يَقْرَأُ بِفَاتِحَةِ اَلْكِتَابِ وَ يُصَلِّي عَلَى اَلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّى اَللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ»

items.e: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr from Musa ibn Bakr from Abu al-Hasan (a.s): Imam (a.s) said: “When you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a woman, stand at her head; and when you pray (Salat Al Mayyit) over a man, stand at his chest.”
items.o: سهل بن زياد عن احمد بن محمد بن ابي نصر عن موسى بن بكر عن ابي الحسن عليه السلام قال إذا صليت على المرأة فقم عند رأسها وأذا صليت على الرجل فقم عند صدره

items.e: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Yahya ibn Zakariyya, from his father Zakariyya ibn Musa, from al-Qasim ibn Ubaydullah al-Qummi, said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s) about a man who prays over a funeral alone. Imam (a.s) said: “Yes (it is allowed).” I asked: “And what if two pray over it?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes (it is allowed), but the other should stand behind the one leading, and not stand beside him.”
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنْ يَحْيَى بْنِ زَكَرِيَّا عَنْ أَبِيهِ زَكَرِيَّا بْنِ مُوسَى عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْقُمِّيِّ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنِ اَلرَّجُلِ يُصَلِّي عَلَى جِنَازَةٍ وَحْدَهُ قَالَ« نَعَمْ» قُلْتُ فَاثْنَانِ يُصَلِّيَانِ عَلَيْهَا قَالَ «نَعَمْ وَ لَكِنْ يَقُومُ اَلْآخَرُ خَلْفَ اَلْآخَرِ وَ لاَ يَقُومُ بِجَنْبِهِ»

items.e: Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “The Prophet, may Allah (swt) bless him and his family, said: ‘The best of the rows in prayer is the front one, and the best of the rows in funerals is the last one.’ It was asked: “O Messenger of Allah (swt), and why is that?” Prophet (saws) said: “Because it becomes a screen (barrier), for the women.”
items.o: عَلِيٌّ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ اَلنَّوْفَلِيِّ عَنِ اَلسَّكُونِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« قَالَ اَلنَّبِيُّ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَ آلِهِ: «خَيْرُ اَلصُّفُوفِ فِي اَلصَّلاَةِ اَلْمُقَدَّمُ وَ خَيْرُ اَلصُّفُوفِ فِي اَلْجَنَائِزِ اَلْمُؤَخَّرُ» قِيلَ يَا رَسُولَ اَللَّهِ وَلِمَ قَالَ« صَارَ سُتْرَةً لِلنِّسَاءِ»»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Is it permitted to pray over the deceased in the mosque?” Imam (a.s) said: “Yes.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَعِيدٍ عَنْ فَضَالَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنِ اَلْفَضْلِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اَلْمَلِكِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَلْ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ فِي اَلْمَسْجِدِ قَالَ« نَعَمْ»

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two Imams (a.s), peace be upon them: The same as that.
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِ بْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَحَدِهِمَا عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ: مِثْلَ ذَلِكَ.

items.e: Sa’ad ibn Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Yazid ibn Ishaq Sha'ir, from Harun ibn Hamzah, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “When the time of an obligatory prayer enters, begin with it before the prayer over the deceased, unless the deceased had abdominal illness (mabtun) or was a woman in postpartum bleeding (nufasa) or something like that.” (meaning to hurry and pray Salat Al Mayyit and bury such deceased with such cases)
items.o: سَعْدُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ إِسْحَاقَ شَعِرٍ عَنْ هَارُونَ بْنِ حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« إِذَا دَخَلَ وَقْتُ صَلاَةٍ مَكْتُوبَةٍ فَابْدَأْ بِهَا قَبْلَ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْمَيِّتِ إِلاَّ أَنْ يَكُونَ مَبْطُوناً أَوْ نُفَسَاءَ أَوْ نَحْوَ ذَلِكَ»

items.e: Ali ibn al-Husayn, from Ahmad ibn Idris, from Muhammad ibn Salim, from Ahmad ibn al-Nadr, from Amr ibn Shimr, from Jabir, said: I said to Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him: “If I am present for the funeral prayer at the time of an obligatory prayer, which one should I begin with?” Imam (a.s) said: “Hasten the deceased to his grave, unless you fear that the time for the obligatory prayer will pass. And do not delay the prayer over the deceased until the rising of the sun or its setting.” (meaning to hasten to bury the deceased, as possible)
items.o: عَلِيُّ بْنُ اَلْحُسَيْنِ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ إِدْرِيسَ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ اَلنَّضْرِ عَنْ عَمْرِو بْنِ شِمْرٍ عَنْ جَابِرٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ إِذَا حَضَرْتُ اَلصَّلاَةَ عَلَى اَلْجِنَازَةِ فِي وَقْتِ مَكْتُوبَةٍ فَبِأَيِّهَا أَبْدَأُ فَقَالَ« عَجِّلِ اَلْمَيِّتَ إِلَى قَبْرِهِ إِلاَّ أَنْ تَخَافَ أَنْ يَفُوتَ وَقْتُ اَلْفَرِيضَةِ وَ لاَ تَنْتَظِرْ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ طُلُوعَ اَلشَّمْسِ وَ لاَ غُرُوبَهَا»

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Musa ibn al-Qasim al-Bajali and Abu Qatadah al-Qummi, from Ali ibn Ja’far, from his brother Musa ibn Ja’far, peace be upon them, said: I asked Imam al-Kadhim (a.s) about the funeral prayer if the sun has turned red, does it become valid or not? Imam (a.s) said: “There is no prayer during the time of (another) prayer.” And Imam (a.s) said: “When the sun sets, then perform the Maghrib prayer, then perform the prayer over the funeral.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ اَلْبَجَلِيِّ وَ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ اَلْقُمِّيِّ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَنْ أَخِيهِ مُوسَى بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِمَا اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ صَلاَةِ اَلْجَنَائِزِ إِذَا اِحْمَرَّتِ اَلشَّمْسُ أَ يَصْلُحُ أَوْلاَ قَالَ« لاَ صَلاَةَ فِي وَقْتِ صَلاَةٍ» وَ قَالَ« إِذَا وَجَبَتِ اَلشَّمْسُ فَصَلِّ اَلْمَغْرِبَ ثُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ

items.e: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from more than one person, from Aban, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: “Do any of these hours prevent you from praying over the funerals?” Imam (a.s) said, “No.”
items.o: حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ هَلْ يَمْنَعُكَ شَيْءٌ مِنْ هَذِهِ اَلسَّاعَاتِ عَنِ اَلصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ فَقَالَ« لاَ»

items.e: Abu Ali al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: Imam al-Baqir (a.s) said: “The funeral prayer is performed at any hour, for it is not a prayer of bowing (ruku') or prostration (sujud). Rather, what is disliked is the prayer at sunrise and at sunset the one that contains humility (khushu), bowing (rukuh), and prostration (sujud) because sun sets between the horns of a devil and it rises between the horns of a devil.” (meaning metaphorical warning not to imitate non-Islamic or pagan rituals as they used to do)
items.o: أبو علي الاشعري عن محمد بن عبد الجبار عن صفوان بن يحيى عن العلا بن رزين عن محمد بن مسلم عن ابي جعفر عليه السلام قال يصلى على الجنازة في كل ساعة انها ليست بصلاة ركوع ولا سجود وإنما تكره الصلاة عند طلوع الشمس وعند غروبها التي فيها الخشوع والركوع والسجود لانها تغرب بين قرني شيطان وتطلع بين قرني شيطان

items.e: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Ubaydullah al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “There is no harm in performing the funeral prayer when the sun sets and when it rises; it is merely a seeking of forgiveness.”
items.o: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ اِبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ حَمَّادِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ اَللَّهِ اَلْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: «لاَ بَأْسَ بِالصَّلاَةِ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ حِينَ تَغِيبُ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ حِينَ تَطْلُعُ إِنَّمَا هُوَ اِسْتِغْفَارٌ»

items.e: As for what was narrated by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from al-Qasim ibn Muhammad from Aban from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) said: “It is disliked to perform the funeral prayer when the sun turns yellow and when it rises.”
items.o: فَأَمَّا مَا رَوَاهُ اَلْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ سَعِيدٍ عَنِ اَلْقَاسِمِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« تُكْرَهُ اَلصَّلاَةُ عَلَى اَلْجَنَائِزِ حِينَ تَصْفَرُّ اَلشَّمْسُ وَ حِينَ تَطْلُعُ»

items.e: Sahl ibn Ziyad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from al-Ala ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Muslim, from Abu Ja’far (a.s), peace be upon him, said: I asked Imam al-Baqir (a.s): “How is the funeral prayer performed over men and women?” (meaning the congregation) Imam (a.s) said: “The men are placed in the front where the men stand, and the women are placed behind the men.”
items.o: سَهْلُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ أَبِي نَصْرٍ عَنِ اَلْعَلاَءِبْنِ رَزِينٍ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ كَيْفَ يُصَلَّى عَلَى اَلرِّجَالِ وَ اَلنِّسَاءِ فَقَالَ« يُوضَعُ اَلرِّجَالُ مِمَّا يَلِي اَلرِّجَالَ وَ اَلنِّسَاءُ خَلْفَ اَلرِّجَالِ»

items.e: From him, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, who said: When Imam (a.s) performed the funeral prayer over a woman and a man (together), He (a.s) would place the woman in front (of the man) and the man behind (meaning closest to the imam of prayer). And when Imam (a.s) performed the funeral prayer over a slave and a free man (together), he would place the slave in front (of the free man) and the free man behind (meaning closest to the imam of prayer). And when Imam (a.s) performed the funeral prayer over a child and an elder (together), He (a.s) would place the child in front (of the elder) and the elder behind (meaning closest to the imam of prayer).”
items.o: عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ عَنْ طَلْحَةَ بْنِ زَيْدٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ قَالَ:« كَانَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى اَلْمَرْأَةِ وَاَلرَّجُلِ قَدَّمَ اَلْمَرْأَةَ وَ أَخَّرَ اَلرَّجُلَ فَإِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى اَلْعَبْدِ وَ اَلْحُرِّ قَدَّمَ اَلْعَبْدَ وَ أَخَّرَ اَلْحُرَّ وَ إِذَا صَلَّى عَلَى اَلصَّغِيرِ وَ اَلْكَبِيرِ قَدَّمَ اَلصَّغِيرَ وَ أَخَّرَ اَلْكَبِيرَ»

items.e: Humayd ibn Ziyad, from al-Hasan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama'ah, from more than one person, from Aban ibn Uthman, from Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Abdillah, said: I asked Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him, about the funerals of men and women, when they are gathered (prayed upon) together. Imam (a.s) said: “The men are placed in front, this is in the ‘Book of Ali (a.s)’, peace be upon him.” (meaning the women bier is placed, then the man, who will be closest to the imam of prayer)
items.o: حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ اَلْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ سَمَاعَةَ عَنْ غَيْرِ وَاحِدٍ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اَلرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ قَالَ: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ عَنْ جَنَائِزِ اَلرِّجَالِ وَ اَلنِّسَاءِ إِذَا اِجْتَمَعَتْ فَقَالَ« تُقَدَّمُ اَلرِّجَالُ فِي كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ عَلَيْهِ اَلسَّلاَمُ»

items.e: Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ali, from Amr ibn Sa’id, from Musaddiq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar ibn Musa, from Abu Abdillah (a.s), peace be upon him: Imam al-Sadiq (a.s) was asked regarding a man who performs the funeral prayer over two or three deceased persons (together), how should he pray over them? Imam (a.s) said: “If they are three, or two, or ten, or more than that, let him perform one prayer over them. He (leader of prayer) should pronounce five takbirs over them, just as he does for a single deceased person. He has thus prayed over all of them. He should place one deceased person, then place the next one at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the first, then place the head of the third at the buttocks (aliyah) of the second, in a stepped arrangement (shibh al-madrar) until he finishes arranging all of them, however many they may be. Once he has arranged them like this, he should stand in the middle and pronounce five takbirs, doing just as he would when praying over a single deceased person.” Imam (a.s) was asked, “And if they are deceased men and women?” Imam (a.s) said: “He begins with the men, placing the head of the second at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the first, until he finishes with all the men. Then he places the head of the woman at the buttocks (Aliyah) of the last man. Then he places the head of the next woman at the head of the first woman, until he finishes arranging all of them. Once he has arranged them in this way, he stands in the middle, in the center of the men, and pronounces the takbirs and performs the prayer over them just as he does when praying over a single deceased person.” Imam (a.s) was asked about a deceased person over whom the funeral prayer was performed, and after the imam (of prayer) had given the taslim, it was discovered that the deceased was turned around, with his feet where his head should have been. Imam (a.s) said: “He should be straightened, and the prayer should be repeated over him. And if he had been carried away but not yet buried, then it is to be repeated. But if he has already been buried, then the prayer has passed and is not to be repeated while he is buried.”
